operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run check:deployment-spec && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs check && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs verify-base --offline && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm run verify
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: pause writes, retain the exact source and private settings, export Larder data, restore into empty resources, establish the native owner, re-export and compare records and attachment bytes before routing traffic. Preserve every applied migration name and byte.
